svg.title: Starting landscape (stage 0 for every boundary)
svg.desc: Rolling lowland; low ridges and stream valleys run left to right across the middle of the block. Front face: flat rock layers over the crystalline crust, a crust band of uniform thickness, mantle below.
svg.text: Rolling lowland; low ridges and stream valleys run left to right across the middle of the block.
Front face: flat rock layers over the crystalline crust, a crust band of uniform thickness, mantle below.
Storyboard (7A), authored from the 7A table; not simulated; not production art. Heights, layers ×4; crust base ×0.75.
